subject: Request: CAIQ/SIG evidence — JIT admin & service-account separation
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@daylighthealth.com>

Cc: security@daylighthealth.com
Date: 2026-08-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: CAIQ/SIG - JIT admin & service-account separation

Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this. Daylight is preparing our vendor assessment for Q3 and we need a focused evidence package covering service-account separation, just-in-time (JIT) admin controls, and SCIM/SAML proof points. The primary ask is for items we can upload into our SIG/CAIQ intake within one week. Could you confirm you can provide the following by EOD 2026-08-19?:

1) Service account inventory (CSV) showing: owner, purpose, creation date, last-used timestamp, and an indicator for whether the account is blocked or rotated.
2) JIT admin flow documentation and a short workback (screenshots or logs) showing an ephemeral admin session being issued and revoked.
3) SAML assertion samples (sanitized) for a typical user login and an elevated (admin) session.
4) SCIM delta extracts (time-windowed) demonstrating provisioning events and a map from SCIM attributes to RBAC roles.
5) Evidence of least-privilege: a role-owner roster and a recent role-claim reconciliation snapshot.

We can accept sanitized artifacts via SFTP (details below) or a shared Drive link. If you need a narrower scope for initial delivery (e.g., provide inventory + JIT docs first), please propose a prioritized list and ETA.

Attached is our CAIQ checklist that highlights the controls we're mapping these artifacts to. If any of the items are covered by a centralized audit report (SOC 2 control reference), call that out and include the report ID.

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Park
Vendor Security Analyst | Daylight Health
security@daylighthealth.com
